correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 9840 ternary words of lengths1..8 against both orientations of the seven literal patterns {00,11,22,20,212,0101,121012}; exact T_n sets and first emptiness at T_8 established, so longer both-direction permitted factors impossible by subfactor inheritance. Verified all T_1..T_7 words and reverses occur in h^7(0) of length65; standard prefix inclusion holds since h(0) starts 0. Inspected Currie et al Theorem14 avoiding a superset of F and Theorem1 rho(n)=2n+1. Pair-count formula r(n)=rho(n)−nonpalindromic_reflected(n)/2 yields all counts. Finite exhaustive obstruction plus published infinite avoidance/complexity theorems, not finite prefix extrapolation, establish the all-length result.
